description.value: The Hestia Veggie is a fully vegan restaurant on Davie Street in Vancouver's West End, drawing on Asian culinary traditions to create vibrant, plant-based dishes spanning breakfast, lunch, dinner, and drinks. The kitchen emphasises bold flavours, fresh ingredients, and thoughtful visual presentation in an entirely vegan setting with no non-vegan options. The restaurant also offers catering and group orders with free delivery within downtown Vancouver, making it a practical stop for cyclists looking to fuel up or arrange a group meal.
